longDescription: I grew up in Kuching, a small city on the island of Borneo. As a kid I always dreamt of leaving home to explore beyond my horizons, and I've been fortunate enough to study mechanical engineering at two of the world's best universities. At UCL I'm on track for First Class Honours, and in 2025 I won the Frederic Barnes Waldron Best Student Award, given to the student with the highest year average across the whole university. I spent my third year on exchange at UC Berkeley and finished with a 4.00 GPA. Outside of the classroom, I spent a year researching photon detector cooling at Berkeley's FLOW Lab, and wrote a paper under Prof. Liwei Lin studying the use of nanowires in solid-state thermoelectric cooling. On the competitive side, I was the recovery systems lead for UCL Rocketry's entries at the Spaceport America Cup (SAC) 2025 and the National Rocketry Championship (NRC) 2024. Closest to my heart is the Sarawak Student Initiative, which I started in 2021. Education opportunities in my home state are nowhere near equal, and I know how much difference one person's guidance can make. SSI exists so that every student in Sarawak, wherever they start from, gets a real chance to go out and see the world.
